terminal_config.title: Terminal Configurations
terminal_config.gctHint: The base32 key shown in the GCT panel next to the QR code. A fresh one-time code is computed from it on each login.

tracking_job.title: Terminal Tracking Jobs
tracking_job.noEvents: No terminal events yet. Use "Poll now" to fetch.

unknown.label: Unknown hold
unknown.description: Unrecognised terminal hold. Refer to the terminal for details.
unknown.resolution: Contact the terminal to determine how this hold is cleared.

cfs_appointment.label: CFS appointment
cfs_appointment.description: Applied while a CFS (warehouse) import order is being accepted.
cfs_appointment.resolution: Cleared automatically once the order is completed and warehouse work is done.

customs_import_permission.label: Customs import permission
customs_import_permission.description: Applied systematically to every import container pending customs release.
customs_import_permission.resolution: Removed automatically after the MRN number is updated via the Polish PCS codes.

customs_import_hold.label: Customs import hold
customs_import_hold.description: Placed manually by a customs officer for scanning, inspection or a clearance issue.
customs_import_hold.resolution: Only a customs officer can lift it — contact the customs office.

line_import_permission.label: Line import permission
line_import_permission.description: Applied systematically to every import container until the shipping line releases it.
line_import_permission.resolution: Removed once the line releases the container via its PIN number.

oog_hold.label: OOG hold
oog_hold.description: Applied to out-of-gauge import containers that require special handling permits.
oog_hold.resolution: Must be verified by Baltic Hub before pickup; the container cannot be notified for collection until then.

cfs_hold.label: CFS hold
cfs_hold.description: Applied while a CFS (warehouse) export order is being accepted.
cfs_hold.resolution: Cleared automatically once the order is completed and warehouse work is done.

customs_export_permission.label: Customs export permission
customs_export_permission.description: Applied systematically to export containers pending customs release.
customs_export_permission.resolution: Removed automatically after the MRN update; must be cleared before the customs-clearance deadline.

customs_export_hold.label: Customs export hold
customs_export_hold.description: Placed manually by a customs officer for scanning, inspection or a clearance issue.
customs_export_hold.resolution: Only a customs officer can lift it — contact the customs office.

unit_vgm_load_permission.label: VGM load permission
unit_vgm_load_permission.description: Applied to every full export container that has no verified gross mass yet.
unit_vgm_load_permission.resolution: Removed when the VGM weight is uploaded to Navis.

dgd_hold.label: DGD hold
dgd_hold.description: Applied automatically to every export container carrying IMO (dangerous) cargo.
dgd_hold.resolution: Requires the DGD (dangerous-goods declaration) document to be submitted.

scanning_hold.label: Scanning hold
scanning_hold.description: Placed manually by a customs officer; the container must be presented for scanning.
scanning_hold.resolution: Cleared by customs after scanning (DCT_CFS_SCANNING selection).

empty_permission.label: Empty permission
empty_permission.description: Applied systematically to every empty container pending a release reference.
empty_permission.resolution: Removed once the EDO / booking number from the shipping line is provided.

missing_agent_permission.label: Missing agent permission
missing_agent_permission.description: Relates to an inactive PCS payment. Does not currently block ship loading or pickup.
missing_agent_permission.resolution: Removed by entering the shipping code in the Agent One field.

technical_full_container.label: Technical (full container)
technical_full_container.description: Applied to every full import/export container to support OCR character recognition. Does not block movement.

technical_live_reefer.label: Technical (live reefer)
technical_live_reefer.description: Applied to every full reefer container to support OCR. Does not block operations.

terminal_hold.label: Terminal hold
terminal_hold.description: Applied for a container irregularity (incorrect labelling, bent container beams, etc.).
terminal_hold.resolution: Contact Baltic Hub Customer Service to resolve.

czrm_hold.label: CZRM hold
czrm_hold.resolution: Contact the customs office directly to have it lifted.

izrx_hold.label: IZRX hold
izrx_hold.resolution: Contact the customs office directly to have it lifted.
